description: This file contains definitions for difficulty levels, detailed prompt templates, and functions to generate medical education MCQs and validation prompts for exam preparation.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt template for creating high-quality medical MCQs based on difficulty, context, and content type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring criteria.
